description: Header file defining the FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler class, which manages media playback operations such as init, seek, write samples, set pause, set playback rate, set volume, set bounds, and stop. It also handles error reporting, prerolled and ended events, and provides access to the current decode target. The class is part of the starboard::shared::starboard::player::filter namespace and interacts with various media components.

classes.name: FilterBasedPlayerWorkerHandler
classes.description: Handles media playback operations for a filter-based player, including initialization, seeking, writing samples, setting playback parameters, and error handling. It manages internal components like media time provider, audio and video renderers, and interacts with the player and media components.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the player handler with the given player and callback functions.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified time in the media stream.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Writes input buffers (samples) to the media pipeline.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of stream for a specific media type.

methods.name: SetMaxVideoInputSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size for video input.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target for rendering.
